messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi! I have a Platinum Rewards Card and I think there’s some kind of annual fee rebate if you spend a certain amount each month. I’ve had the card for about a year now and I’m wondering if I qualify for the rebate. Can you check my account and let me know?

{"text":"I can help check your Platinum Rewards card for the annual-fee rebate, but I need to verify your identity before accessing your account. Please provide either your Rho user ID, the email on your account, or your full name so I can look up your profile, AND provide any two of the following: date of birth (MM/DD/YYYY), phone number, or mailing address. After you provide those, I’ll verify and then check your rebate eligibility. If you’d rather not share that here, I can transfer you to a human agent—would you like that instead?"}
